text: Arnemetia is a British goddess. Her name comes from nemeton, the word for a sacred grove. It means in front of the sacred grove. Two mineral springs rose close together at her grove. The Romans called that site Aquae Arnementiae, the waters of Arnemetia. The place is today's Buxton Spa in Derbyshire. After Christianization she became Saint Anne.
